entities.summary: Marc Joseph Habscheid is a former National Hockey League player and the current head coach of the Red Deer Rebels of the Western Hockey League. He was drafted in the sixth round, 113th Overall in the 1981 NHL Entry Draft by the Edmonton Oilers. He played 345 games in the NHL over parts of 10 seasons, amassing 72 goals and 163 points.
